The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Seafood Meunières by [[Cooking]] [[Tabantha Wheat]], [[Goat Butter]], and any [[Seafood]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The only exceptions to this are [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], and [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], as including these [[Fish]] will result in different [[Meal]]s. The default version of Seafood Meunière can be made either by using [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]]s, which offer no status effects, or by using multiple types of Seafood with differing effects. Eating these Meals will heal some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. The secret [[Ingredient]] to Seafood Meunière is a lot of love. When making Seafood Meunière, Link can make the following variations, based on both the type of seafood used as well as additional Ingredients: * '''Hearty Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Seafood Meunière}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, these will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Energizing Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Seafood Meunière}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing Ingredients. By eating them, Link can refill part of his [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Seafood Meunière}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely refreshed and overfilled if he eats them. * '''Hasty Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Seafood Meunière}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using hasty Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link a boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Seafood Meunière}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other Ingredients. If Link consumes these meals, he will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Seafood Meunière}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other spicy Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Seafood Meunière}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other mighty Ingredients. Eating them will provide Link with a boost to his attack power. * '''Tough Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Seafood Meunière}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other tough Ingredients. Link's defensive abilities will be increased if he eats these. * '''Sneaky Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Seafood Meunière}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, or other sneaky Ingredients. These meals will provide a boost to Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Chilly Seafood Meunière''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Seafood Meunière}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Rich butter flanks fresh seafood. The secret ingredient is lots and lots of love.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Consuming them will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Seafood Meunières can be made by [[Cooking]] any type of [[Seafood]], excluding [[Hearty Salmon]]s and [[Porgy|Porgies]], with [[Goat Butter]] and [[Tabantha Wheat]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Porgy Meunière * Salmon Meunière }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
